target: Restore the intended nested daily-chart presentation and recover native capture from token-ledger cursor resets and overlapping pending parent-summary jobs.
primary_semantics: Daily metrics remain unchanged while presentation is corrected; native visible-message progress remains independent from derived token-ledger replay; pending parent jobs reserve their child summaries.
invariants: Raw rollout files, append-only raw memory, persisted summaries, trusted devices, and cloud replicas are never rewritten or deleted.
The daily chart continues to display local values nested inside all-trusted-device values with the existing Asia/Tokyo boundary.
A repair keeps the earlier pending parent job and preserves every later conflicting derived job in a SHA-256 receipt before removing it from the active queue.
Token-ledger reconstruction remains derived entirely from retained Codex token_count telemetry.
allowed_changes: Move bold date labels below the chart baseline, make nested bars equal width, and improve blue/green contrast.
Recover archived visible-message high-water from immutable raw source metadata independently of token-ledger scan position.
Exclude children already assigned to pending parent jobs and quarantine later legacy overlaps during explicit repair.
Add focused regressions, release evidence, version metadata, and three-locale release notes.
prohibited_changes: Change daily metric aggregation, federation protocol, date boundaries, or token definitions.
Rewrite, truncate, normalize, or delete raw history or persisted summaries.
Silence unrelated integrity failures or treat an incomplete repair as healthy.
before_after_checks: Render desktop and mobile daily charts and assert visible bold dates below the baseline and equal-width nested bars.
Replay a rollout longer than 512 lines after a token-ledger cursor reset and require zero immutable-message collisions.
Create overlapping pending parent jobs, repair them, and verify the earlier job remains with a SHA-256 quarantine receipt for the later job.
Run the candidate against the preserved Windows archive and require caught_up true and audit status ok.
